title: Find Words Containing Character
summary: Given an array of strings and a character, return an array of indices for words containing the specified character, in any order.
statement: Given an array of strings and a character, return an array of indices for words containing the specified character, in any order.
constraints: Inspect each word for the given single lowercase character x.
Return the zero-based indices of every word containing x at least once.
Indices must be returned in increasing order.
reference_solution:
def word_indices_containing_character(words,x):
    return [index for index,word in enumerate(words) if x in word]
hints: Each word can be decided independently.
Enumerate words in their original order.
Append the current index whenever membership testing finds x in the word.
Enumeration preserves increasing indices and includes exactly all qualifying words.
editorial: Enumeration preserves increasing indices and includes exactly all qualifying words.
